I'm a mathematics major with a minor in data science at Pomona College (class of 2028). I work as a research assistant at STATSLab at Claremont McKenna College, tutor at Pomona's Quantitative Skills Center, and a mentor for multiple courses. I speak Spanish (native fluency), English (bilingual fluency), and French (advanced).
